about_short_description.short_description: NYM Technologies SA is a privacy-centric startup

product.name: Nym Mixnet
product.description: A decentralized network that routes internet traffic through multiple nodes to obfuscate metadata and protect user privacy at the network level.

product.name: NymVPN
product.description: A decentralized VPN service that uses the Nym Mixnet to provide anonymous and unlinkable internet activity across multiple platforms.

product.name: NYM Token
product.description: The native utility token used to incentivize and reward operators within the Nym Mixnet ecosystem.

product.name: Nym Wallet
product.description: A software wallet for managing NYM tokens, bonding nodes, delegating stakes, and earning rewards within the Nym ecosystem.

product.name: Nym SDKs and Developer Tools
product.description: Software development kits and tools for integrating applications with the Nym Mixnet to enable privacy-preserving features.

product.name: Nym iOS app
product.description: An iOS application providing access to Nym’s decentralized VPN service.
